effects.printed_clause: If Normal/Special Summoned: add another "Arckcestial", then Normal/Special Summon only LIGHT Spellcasters for rest turn; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Cloned summon triggers search another archetype card and always register both cannot-Normal-Summon and cannot-Special-Summon filters through end turn; id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: If sent as Synchro Material for a LIGHT monster: target another Level 4 or lower "Arckcestial" in GY and add it; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed material trigger checks Synchro reason/LIGHT reason card, targets a Necrovalley-legal candidate, and returns it under separate HOPT.

coverage_override.reason: The Summon search plus Normal/Special Summon lock is one compound effect; the LIGHT Synchro-material GY recovery is the second, and both records include their HOPTs.
